description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of categories within a 1.4 million item open-source distilled reasoning dataset. The chart contains seven slices, each representing a different category. The “Math” category is represented by a red slice and comprises approximately 29.3% of the dataset. “Coding” is shown in blue and accounts for roughly 24.3%. A light blue slice represents “Information Seeking” at 22.2%, while “Reasoning” is depicted in green and makes up about 10.4%. The “Others (combined)” category is shown in gray and represents 9.3% of the dataset. “Creative Writing” is represented by a pink slice at 2.2%, and “Planning” is shown in purple at 2.3%. A legend is present in the upper left corner, labeling each category and providing the corresponding count. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and the slices appear to be ordered clockwise from largest to smallest proportion.
